clause_text: Female employees are entitled to 12 weeks of maternity leave.
notes: Law requires 26 weeks, policy says 12

clause_text: Employees may avail maternity leave for a period of 3 months.
notes: 3 months = ~13 weeks, law requires 26 weeks

clause_text: Employee personal data may be shared with third-party service providers without prior notification.
notes: DPDP requires explicit consent before sharing

clause_text: The company collects employee data for operational purposes.
notes: No purpose limitation clause, vague 'operational purposes'

clause_text: The company promotes a respectful work environment.
notes: Talks about respect but no ICC constituted

clause_text: Employee records will be maintained as per company requirements.
notes: No data erasure / right to be forgotten clause

clause_text: Annual leave is provided as per management discretion.
notes: Vague, no specific timely payment or leave entitlement

clause_text: Data is stored on company servers with standard practices.
notes: No specific security measures mentioned (encryption, audits)

clause_text: New employees undergo a general orientation program.
notes: General orientation, no specific POSH awareness training

clause_text: Employee concerns may be raised with the HR department informally.
notes: No formal grievance redressal mechanism for data principals

clause_text: The company may terminate employment at any time without notice.
notes: Law requires notice period for termination

clause_text: Maternity leave of 18 weeks is available for all female staff.
notes: 18 weeks is less than required 26 weeks

clause_text: The company has constituted an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) comprising a Presiding Officer, two internal members, and one external member from an NGO.
notes: Fully compliant ICC structure

clause_text: Every female employee is entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for the first two children.
notes: Exact compliance with 26 weeks requirement

clause_text: Personal data shall be processed only after obtaining explicit, informed consent from the data principal.
notes: Explicit consent clause present

clause_text: Employees have the right to request erasure of their personal data upon termination of employment.
notes: Data erasure right properly addressed

clause_text: The company implements encryption, access controls, and regular security audits as reasonable security practices.
notes: Specific security measures listed

clause_text: Wages are paid within 7 days of the close of the wage period via direct bank transfer.
notes: Timely payment within 7 days

clause_text: A crèche facility is available for employees with children below 6 years of age.
notes: Creche facility provided

clause_text: Mandatory POSH awareness workshops are conducted quarterly for all employees.
notes: Regular POSH training conducted

clause_text: Provident Fund contributions of 12% of basic wages are deducted and deposited monthly.
notes: PF at 12% as required

clause_text: The company contributes 2% of average net profit over the last three financial years towards CSR activities.
notes: CSR 2% compliance

clause_text: We provide generous maternity benefits as per applicable laws.
notes: Edge case: vague reference to 'applicable laws', no specific 26-week mention

clause_text: Employee data is handled responsibly.
notes: Edge case: too vague, no consent mechanism, no specifics

clause_text: All complaints regarding workplace behavior will be addressed by the HR team.
notes: Edge case: HR handles complaints but no ICC, no formal POSH structure

clause_text: Employees are required to maintain confidentiality of all company and client information during and after employment.
notes: Confidentiality clause covers Section 72A requirements

clause_text: Either party may terminate employment by providing 30 days written notice or salary in lieu thereof.
notes: Proper notice period clause

clause_text: In the event of a data breach, the company will notify affected individuals and the Data Protection Board within 72 hours.
notes: Proper breach notification with timeline

clause_text: As a startup with fewer than 10 employees, the company is exempt from maintaining a formal Internal Complaints Committee (ICC), and harassment complaints will be addressed directly by the founder.
notes: Under POSH, <10 employees must route to Local Complaints Committee (LCC), NOT founder. Negation + misstatement of law.

clause_text: Employees currently serving their probationary period are not required to be enrolled in the Employees' Provident Fund scheme until their successful confirmation.
notes: EPF enrollment mandatory from day one including probation. Negation ('are not required') creates direct conflict.

clause_text: This POSH policy does not apply to incidents occurring outside the registered office premises or outside of regular working hours.
notes: POSH Act defines 'extended workplace' covering transport, offsites, virtual environments. 'Does not apply' contradicts extended workplace definition.

clause_text: The provisions of the Payment of Gratuity Act shall not apply to consultants and independent contractors engaged for a fixed term.
notes: Correct statement — gratuity genuinely does not apply to contractors. Negation clause that is actually compliant.

clause_text: Female employees who have worked for at least 80 days in the preceding 12 months are eligible for a maternity leave of approximately 12 weeks.
source: Pre-2017 Handbook Template (public university HR portal)
notes: Pre-amendment number. 2017 amendment raised from 12 to 26 weeks. Word 'approximately' makes it harder for keyword check.

clause_text: The employee and the employer will each contribute 10% of the basic salary towards the Provident Fund.
notes: Statutory rate is 12%, not 10%. Tests quantity checker: 10 < 12 required_value with comparison_type='min'.

clause_text: Overtime wages will be paid at 1.5 times the normal hourly rate for any work extending beyond 9 hours a day.
notes: Indian law requires 2x (double) not 1.5x. American overtime standard wrongly copied. Tests non-maternity numeric conflict.

clause_text: To be eligible for Gratuity payout, an employee must complete a minimum of 6 years of continuous service with the organization.
notes: Legal threshold is 5 years, not 6. Off-by-one error. Tests whether engine catches slightly inflated eligibility threshold.

clause_text: Leave encashment upon termination shall be calculated as per Cl. 4(ii)(a) ibid, subject to (a) completion of 240 days service; provided however that... the computation excludes HRA.
source: Ministry of Labour Draft Model Standing Orders
notes: Cross-references, nested clauses, ellipsis mid-sentence. Tests clause extractor handles fragmented legal prose without false flag.

clause_text: Maternity Benefits: As per the Maternity Benefit Act 1961 (amended 2017), the Employee is entitled to • 26 wks leave • medical bonus of Rs 3500/- *subject to revision... if no prenatal confinement provided.
notes: Bullet fragments mid-sentence, abbreviations ('wks'), dangling asterisk. Correct 26-week figure but messy. Tests clause splitter + quantity extractor.

clause_text: Notwithstanding anything contained hereinabove, the ICC quorum shall consist of 50% members w.r.t the proceedings, sine qua non that the Presiding Officer must be a senior level female employee.
notes: Latin ('sine qua non'), legal boilerplate ('notwithstanding'), abbreviations. Compliant content buried in dense formatting.

clause_text: In re: PF deductions - the establishment, being covered under Section 1(3)(b) of the Act, will deduct EPF @ 12% (see sub-sec 2). *Applicable only to basic + DA.
notes: Legal prefix ('In re:'), shorthand symbols ('@', '+'), dangling asterisk. Correct 12% figure. Tests extractor ignores decorative noise.

clause_text: New mothers receive 182 days of fully compensated time off for childbearing purposes.
notes: 182 days = 26 weeks. Zero overlap with law vocabulary ('childbearing' not 'maternity', '182 days' not '26 weeks'). Tests semantic robustness.

clause_text: Upon separation, team members who have crossed the half-decade milestone with us will be awarded a loyalty payout equivalent to half-a-month's base pay for every year spent.
notes: 'Half-decade' = 5 years gratuity threshold, 'loyalty payout' = gratuity, 'half-a-month base pay' = 15 days wages. Fully compliant, zero jargon match.

clause_text: Our workplace strictly prohibits unwelcome physical, verbal, or visual conduct of a sexual nature, and all such grievances are heard by our internal gender-neutral ethics panel, which is headed by our female VP and includes an external NGO member.
source: MNC Global Code of Conduct (Indian annex)
notes: 'Ethics panel' not 'ICC', 'female VP' satisfies Presiding Officer req, 'external NGO member' satisfies Section 4(1)(c). Tests whether engine recognises structural compliance through paraphrase.
